claims.statement: Net profit for the year 2025 was 22 578 063 × 1,000 L.E. = 22 578 063 000 L.E.
Net profit for the year 2024 was 10 111 328 × 1,000 L.E. = 10 111 328 000 L.E.
Operating revenues 2025 were 106 672 946 × 1,000 L.E. (≈106.7 bn L.E.)
Operating revenues 2024 were 81 677 812 × 1,000 L.E. (≈81.7 bn L.E.)
Total assets at end‑2025 were 225 882 527 × 1,000 L.E. (≈225.9 bn L.E.)
Total equity at end‑2025 was 63 687 826 × 1,000 L.E. (≈63.7 bn L.E.)

limitations: Financial data are based on the 2025 audited consolidated statements; no forecast or forward‑looking information is provided.
The EPS figures are ambiguous because of the L.E.(000) unit and have been excluded from valuation calculations.

Investor portfolio concentration risk: allocating the entire cash reserve (50 000 EGP) into a single stock (ETEL) would expose the portfolio to significant idiosyncratic risk, contrary to the investor’s medium risk tolerance and 5‑year retirement horizon.
Price used (141.95 EGP per share) is the cutoff price; actual execution price may differ.
No transaction costs, taxes, or market impact are modelled.
